name: zfmv_action_run_blocking_immediate
description: zFMV_Action::RunBlockingImmediate begins the action at time zero, repeatedly calls the action update slot with time zero until it returns 0, then calls the action end slot.
known_limits: Tier C only; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zFMV action/source-file pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x462e30 validates the thiscall body: call vtable slot 0x08 Begin with 0.0, call vtable slot 0x04 Update with 0.0 until it returns zero, then call vtable slot 0x0c End.
The dependency frontier has no direct callees or authored source blockers; the indirect calls target the established zFMV action vtable Begin, Update, and End slots.
The native smoke uses the recovered zFMV action vtable contract to verify Begin, Update, and End are called once in order for the zero-update path, with Begin and Update both receiving 0.0.
